_comment: AGENT-EDITABLE self-pacing. The cloud routine ticks hourly and I cannot change that, but I decide which ticks deserve a FULL cycle (scan + research + bet) and which are LIGHT (settle + monitor open positions, then stop). Set next_full_cycle_after when a full cycle would be wasted — e.g. no candidate resolves for hours, or research sources are unavailable. A tick always settles and monitors regardless; skipping those is not allowed. LIGHT ticks skip only scan+research: if resolve.py settles ANYTHING on a light tick, that same tick writes the retro and applies any pre-registered grading — settlement grading is never deferred to a later tick (DEEP-2026-08-05: b21e42c123a1 settled on the 06:24Z light tick, its retro was 'deferred to next full cycle', and the 08:15Z full cycle then saw '0 settled this cycle' and wrote nothing — the $5 loss went ungraded for 23h).
reason: 2026-08-05 17:19Z full cycle: repo hygiene took priority at session start (HEAD was detached with 8 cycle commits stranded unpushed since f44fcab -- git push origin main was silently no-op'ing while HEAD stayed detached; fast-forwarded main to HEAD and pushed, see cycles.log). No unintegrated operator-notes.md guidance (10:53Z item already integrated 13:30Z). scan: 4 queries -> 544 candidates, no fallback. Scheduled-release triage: July unemployment brackets (Aug 7 08:30Z report) -- fresh consensus (Indeed Hiring Lab, 4.29%) matches PM's own bracket peak (4.3% at 35.5%), no edge, re-confirms prior cycles. July CPI cluster (Aug 12) and China CPI/UK GDP (thin liquidity) not re-researched, no new info. Placed 1 book-devig bet: Astros/Blue Jays run line (2363018c118b, Blue Jays +1.5, edge 0.0795 vs min_edge_book_devig 0.07, DraftKings run line devigged, 0.01-spread PM book). Fenerbahce/Sturm Graz not re-bet -- fresh odds came from two different bookmakers with no draw price, a cross-book-mixing trap, and kickoff (18:00Z) was too close by research end to safely dig further. Did not reach WNBA/other MLB/esports candidates this cycle -- time went to the repo-hygiene fix plus the placed candidate. 9 full cycles ran in the last 24h (min_full_cycles_per_day=4, exceeded). Set next_full_cycle_after to 20:19Z (3h cap): no new event boundary sooner -- Astros game (ends ~21:00Z) settles automatically regardless of tick type; WNBA (23:00Z) and evening esports are past the cap. Unresearched WNBA/MLB/esports candidates from this cycle's scan are worth a look then if still open.
notes: Guardrail on my own laziness: even if I keep deferring, run a full cycle if fewer than min_full_cycles_per_day have run in the last 24h (count from journal/cycles.log). Deferring is for saving effort on genuinely empty windows, never for avoiding hard research. Concrete criteria (DEEP-2026-08-04, after 23/23 full cycles including provably redundant re-research at 0115Z/0215Z/0320Z): defer when EVERY current candidate is either (a) researched to a no-edge/no-benchmark conclusion within the last ~2h with no new information since, or (b) gated on a benchmark/status source known unreachable. Set next_full_cycle_after to the next event boundary (kickoff, report time, new candidates entering the window), never more than 3h out, and never past a known event start time. State the reason. Settle + monitor still run every tick, and a settling tick writes its retro immediately (see _comment). Any cycle-count claim in the reason field must be computed from journal/cycles.log (grep, count), not estimated — 2026-08-04/05 reasons asserted '147' and '21' full cycles in 24h, both arithmetically impossible on an hourly tick.
